name: 薄皮手剥原香大核桃款
description: 皮薄易开、果仁饱满、原味香脆的每日坚果套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep roasted brown #3A2418 for opening and closing heroes, warm cream #F7ECD7 for infographic and scene shots, alternating for rhythm
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft warm top light with gentle falloff, 4200-5500K by scene, soft contact shadows, appetizing matte food texture, never plastic-looking
styleLock.surfaceSystem: natural woven bamboo, matte dark wood planks and warm cream paper board
styleLock.typography: modern clean sans-serif headlines, no brush calligraphy
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and simple rounded label tiles in a single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: product always grounded with a soft contact shadow, stable warm-toned scale, heaped or cracked-open presentation to show the kernel
noDrift: no plastic-looking sheen on the food
styleLock.lockText: consistent warm rustic natural-food snack visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep roasted brown #3A2418, warm cream #F7ECD7, dark cocoa text #3B2A1A and one golden amber accent #D9A441; warm tone throughout; soft directional top light with gentle falloff and soft contact shadows; appetizing natural matte food texture, never plastic-looking; modern clean sans-serif headlines; consistent rounded label tiles and thin-line icons; natural woven-wood and cream paper surface language; product always grounded with a soft contact shadow; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏承接点击，用满篮实在感与暖调食欲一秒立住氛围
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down into the bowl, full heap visible
shots.lighting: soft warm top light with gentle falloff, soft contact shadow grounding the bowl
shots.props: round woven bamboo bowl, two small green leaves, a few loose kernels
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_1}」 set on the upper third of the brown field in warm cream #F7ECD7 with a short sub-line 「{selling_point_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce hero banner of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A generous heap of {product} piled in a round woven bamboo bowl, photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down, one cracked-open piece at the center of the pile revealing the kernel. A few loose kernels and two small green leaves scattered on the surface. Soft warm top light with gentle falloff, a soft contact shadow grounding the bowl. Deep roasted brown gradient background #3A2418. A headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in warm cream #F7ECD7 with a short sub-line 「{selling_point_2}」 sits on the upper third of the brown field. The product heap occupies 60-70% of the frame, filling the lower two thirds with the headline zone balanced above. Warm appetizing food rendering with natural matte shell texture. Negative: no brand logo, no calligraphy-style lettering, no red seal stamps, no flying motion-blur objects, no plastic-looking sheen, no watermark, no QR code, no extra text, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒说清皮薄仁满的核心利益，主图一秒法则
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level view, cracked-open piece on a small dish at frame right
shots.lighting: soft warm key light from the upper left, soft contact shadow, controlled highlight on the kernel
shots.textZone: one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #3B2A1A with one thin-line icon in #D9A441 set on the left of the cream field
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One cracked-open {product} resting on a small matte ceramic dish at the right of the frame, photographed from a slight 3/4 eye-level view, the plump kernel facing the camera with the split shell showing how thin it is. Soft warm key light from the upper left with a soft contact shadow and one controlled highlight on the kernel, natural matte food texture. Warm cream background #F7ECD7. One short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #3B2A1A with one thin-line icon in #D9A441 sits on the left of the cream field. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame on the right, balanced by the headline zone on the left. Negative: no more than one claim, no dense body text, no invented efficacy claims, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实早餐时刻，让买家代入每日一把的习惯
shots.camera: eye-level 3/4 candid tabletop view, slightly off-center handheld feel
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadows
shots.background: matte off-white tabletop #F2EEE8 with a softly blurred bright room
shots.props: a glass of milk and a folded linen napkin, not covering the product
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} served in a small wooden bowl on a matte off-white breakfast tabletop #F2EEE8, a softly blurred bright room behind. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from an eye-level 3/4 candid tabletop angle with a slightly off-center handheld feel. Soft morning window light from the left, 5500K, soft contact shadows. Props: a glass of milk and a folded linen napkin, not covering the product. The bowl of {product} occupies 40-50% of the frame at the center of the table, with the milk glass and napkin framing it on the tabletop. A short lower-third caption strip reads 「{callout_1}」 in #3B2A1A. Natural believable food photography, NOT retouched, NOT smoothed. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no deformed fingers, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no messy clutter.

shots.intent: 用果仁纹理微距证明饱满新鲜，激发食欲
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a high 60-degree angle, shallow depth of field, foreground sharp
shots.lighting: raking warm side light from the right revealing kernel texture, controlled highlight
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the kernel of {product}, tight zoom on its natural wrinkled surface. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 60-degree angle as an extreme macro with shallow depth of field, foreground sharp. Raking warm side light from the right revealing every ridge and fold of the kernel, one controlled highlight, natural matte food texture with visible fine details. Deep roasted brown background #3A2418. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with only a minimal clean margin of brown around it, the detail is the whole point. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking sheen, no over-smoothed surface, no duplicated texture patterns, no extra text, no watermark, no props.

shots.intent: 用同框对比证明壳薄易开，消除难剥的顾虑
shots.camera: two matched panels, identical macro side-profile framing and lighting on both sides
shots.lighting: identical soft warm side light on both panels, soft contact shadows
shots.props: left panel only: a metal nutcracker and shell debris
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 / 「{callout_2}」 in #3B2A1A
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison layout, two matched panels with identical camera, framing and lighting. Left panel: an ordinary thick hard nut shell cracked with a metal nutcracker, broken debris scattered around, conveying effort. Right panel: {product} cracked open cleanly by hand, the intact kernel exposed, conveying ease. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Macro side-profile view on both panels, identical soft warm side light, soft contact shadows, natural matte shell texture. Warm cream background #F7ECD7 on both panels. One short label per panel reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #3B2A1A set above each subject. Each panel's product occupies 50-60% of that panel, filling the center with a clean band left for the labels. Negative: no fabricated results, no brand logos on either panel, no hands with deformed fingers, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用严选淘汰的直观图标与承诺横幅降低购买风险
shots.camera: straight-on flat infographic layout, small product group inset at the bottom
shots.lighting: even clean high-key light, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: a row of five crossed-out circle icons in #D9A441
shots.textZone: headline 「{selling_point_3}」 in #3B2A1A, a full-width promise banner 「{selling_point_4}」, two short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on flat layout on warm cream #F7ECD7 with even clean high-key light. A headline 「{selling_point_3}」 in #3B2A1A at the top, below it a row of five simple crossed-out circle icons in #D9A441 conveying defective items being rejected with two short trust labels 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 beside the row, and one full-width rounded promise banner reading 「{selling_point_4}」 in #3B2A1A. At the bottom, a small grounded group of {product} photographed at a slight 3/4 angle with a soft contact shadow; the icon row, banner and product group together fill 50-60% of the frame as one balanced composition. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, test data or statistics; no dense certificates or serial numbers, no fake logos, no watermark, no extra text.

shots.intent: 一张档案卡讲清规格与储存信息，消除规格疑虑
shots.camera: top-down 90-degree flat lay, product group beside the card
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, soft minimal shadow
shots.props: one rounded spec card with four labeled field rows
shots.textZone: rounded card header 「{callout_1}」 and four labeled field rows reading 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」 in #3B2A1A
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce spec infographic for {product}, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A group of {product} with one cracked-open piece arranged beside a single rounded spec card on warm cream paper board #F7ECD7, even high-key flat lighting with a soft minimal shadow. The card has a rounded header reading 「{callout_1}」 and four labeled field rows reading 「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」「{callout_5}」 in #3B2A1A with thin divider lines. The card and product group together occupy 60-70% of the frame, filling the flat lay with an even margin of board around them. Natural matte food texture. Negative: no tiny unreadable text, no dense body paragraphs, no invented spec values, no fake logos, no watermark, no extra text.

shots.intent: 用六宫格覆盖早餐、出行、送礼等享用场景，扩大适用想象
shots.camera: straight-on grid layout, each cell photographed at a slight 3/4 angle
shots.lighting: even warm soft light consistent across all six cells, soft contact shadows
shots.background: warm cream #F7ECD7 page with six rounded photo cells
shots.props: per cell: a small contextual item (glass of milk, travel pouch, gift box, desk notebook), never covering the product
shots.textZone: one rounded label tile under each cell reading 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_6}」 in #3B2A1A
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce usage-grid infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A straight-on 3x2 grid of six rounded photo cells on a warm cream page #F7ECD7; each cell is a compact lifestyle vignette of {product} photographed at a slight 3/4 angle in a different everyday moment (breakfast table, travel pouch, gift box, desk snack, tea time, picnic mat), with even warm soft light and soft contact shadows consistent across all six cells. Each cell keeps the product clearly the subject and carries one rounded label tile below reading 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_6}」 in #3B2A1A. The products occupy 45-55% of the frame overall, with the six cells filling the page and even cream margins between them. Negative: no QR code, no garbled or tiny text, no inconsistent lighting between cells, no duplicated background textures, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text.

shots.intent: 低角度气势收口，用实色行动按钮与短促行动文案促成下单
shots.camera: low angle looking slightly upward at the heap, full pile grounded
shots.lighting: warm top light slightly punchier with a gentle golden rim, soft contact shadow
shots.background: deep roasted brown #3A2418 with matte dark wood surface under the pile
shots.textZone: headline 「{callout_1}」 in #F7ECD7, and one solid rounded #D9A441 CTA button reading 「{callout_2}」 in #3B2A1A
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A generous heap of {product} with one cracked-open piece on a matte dark wood surface, photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward so the pile reads abundant and premium. Warm top light slightly punchier with a gentle golden rim, soft contact shadow grounding the pile, natural matte texture. Deep roasted brown background #3A2418. A headline reading 「{callout_1}」 in warm cream #F7ECD7, and one solid rounded CTA button in #D9A441 reading 「{callout_2}」 in #3B2A1A. The pile occupies 65-75% of the frame, filling the lower two thirds with the headline and button set cleanly on the brown field above. Negative: no real discount numbers, no invented claims or countdowns, no fake logos, no garbled button text, no watermark, no QR code, no extra text.

provenance.notes: 从 9 张薄皮核桃爆款详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌 LOGO、红色印章、书法字风格、原文案、二维码与会员水印；产地与营养成分表述两处自相矛盾且不可验证，一律改为图内具名文案槽由使用方填入真实信息，健康功效类原文（如疾病疗效宣称）全部弃用；产品一律以 {product} 占位。
